Subject: Audit and BYOK requirements for POC

Hi Logan,

Thanks again for the demo last week. We are preparing the procurement pack and need a compact list of gates and artifacts that Redwood can provide for our security and legal teams before the POC kick-off. High level items we care about:

- Audit logs: event types, retention granularity (per-tenant / per-user), export formats (CSV/JSON)
- Data retention windows and deletion guarantees (soft-delete / permanent wipe)
- BYOK/KMS: supported key providers, rotation, and escrow options
- SSO: list of supported SAML attributes, session length & re-auth behavior
- Evidence: SOC2 artifacts, sample audit export, timeline for additional evidence requests

I attached an internal matrix (acme_audit_requirements.xlsx) — can your team confirm which items are currently supported and which would be an exception for POC? Also include an approximate engineering ETA for any gaps.

We'd like a short triage call next week (30m) to go over the non-blocking exceptions.

Thanks,
Sarah
Security Programs | Acme Health

Subject: Re: Fwd: Audit and BYOK requirements for POC — triage needed

Quick draft of what we can tell Acme in the POC window (talking points) — please review:

- Audit logs: We provide per-tenant event logs (authentication, model requests, config changes). Exports: JSON and CSV via console + API. Retention: default 90 days; configurable for Dedicated customers.
- Retention guarantees: For hosted POC, soft-delete within 7 days, permanent wipe scheduled on 30 day SLA after request. Dedicated/Private can request configurable retention windows in contract.
- BYOK/KMS: Support for AWS KMS (customer CMKs) and HashiCorp Vault via transit. No HSM-based escrow in POC. See attached draft notes (redwood-byo-kms-draft.md).
- SSO: SAML 2.0 supported; we map email, name, groups. Session length defaults and re-auth behavior documented in SSO guide.

Open questions that need engineering input:
- Can we produce a per-user, per-request log with token-level latency metadata for exports? (Ben)
- For hosted POC, permanent wipe timeline — can infra guarantee earlier timelines on request? (Priyom)
- Is there a fast path to produce a sample export subset for legal review (Irene)

I've attached a skeleton triage doc we can refine; Logan — once we agree I'll send a trimmed list back to Acme and propose a 30m call.

Attachment: redwood-byo-kms-draft.md

Thanks,
Marissa
Principal Product Manager — Platform
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan@redwood.com>, marissa_cole@redwood.com, irene_choi@redwood.com, priyom_das@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-22T09:08:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Audit/BYOK triage — ops feasibility and short-term workarounds

Putting operational constraints on the table:

- Audit exports: We can provide request-level logs (request id, model name, prompt hash, timestamp, user id) as JSON. Token-level latency/trace requires a small runtime change — estimate 2-4w (low priority).
- Retention/wipe: For hosted POC we can commit to expedited soft-delete + permanent wipe within 14 days if customer signs a limited exception (ops runbook required). Permanent wipe earlier than 14 days requires infra support and an ops SLA.
- BYOK: AWS KMS CMK is immediate. HashiCorp Vault requires onboarding (Docs & keys mapping) — estimate 1-3w for POC-ready automation. HSM escrow is out of scope for POC.
- SSO attributes: we send groups as CSV in assertion; mapping for custom attributes can be added but needs product sign-off.

Action items (assigned):
- Ben: create triage-checklist.pdf (ops responses + caveats) and run a DR test of expedited wipe in staging.
- Priyom: confirm whether permanent wipe can be scripted to <14 days and provide infra risk notes.
- Irene: produce a sample audit export (anonymized) for Acme legal to review.

I'll attach the checklist once it's ready.

--
Ben Carter
Head of Reliability & Security
